author: Explotltdy
quote: Bugged and woke slop. There are far too many quests and plot lines where choices are made for you, denying you the chance to shape the character the way you’d like. The graphics and realism are top-notch, but that’s the only thing the game deserves praise for. The first third of the game feels like a Sims simulator; the plot centers on a female character who behaves in an utterly repulsive and uninteresting way. As for the male character, he’s just a hollow shell—devoid of any distinct traits or narrative background.

author: Explotltdy
quote: Save your money and do not buy this garbage! Gameplay is unplayable and scripted. I have been playing FIFA since 2010, and this is by far the worst game of this series.
